knownFinding.issue: On intra-stream inconsistency the adapter attaches current observation. If first identity is drift X and current identity equals approved Y, finalize(Y) can mark VALIDATED even though output is refused. Following call is then not durably blocked.
knownFinding.minimalFix: Use malformed/no observation for any intra-stream identity/ref inconsistency; add X-to-approved-Y regression proving no output and durable next-dispatch refusal.
knownFinding.state: NOT_FIXED: parent instructed stop new changes for context checkpoint.

limitations: Observed SSE buffered until complete native validation and durable finalize, bounded by existing transport max_stream_bytes; latency differs from immutable incremental streaming.
Unit mocks do not prove PostgreSQL/end-to-end product/provider semantics; no Docker, provider calls, secrets, migrations, pre-pr or Linux CI for this draft.
No independent review: author work only. Parent will review and obtain separate general/security review.
No real model profiles, seeds, approval, grants, monthly budget, business labels or regions created; unconfigured remains default.
Identity operator intentionally does not activate full model profile status/approval timestamps. Actual activation lacks a narrow owner CLI path in existing code; not implemented here.
Trusted caller authorizer, exact managed-version resolver and budget ledger must be injected. No Run producer/ADR129/WorkerRuntime changes.
Unknown outcome/finalization failure preserves existing durable pending barrier; no new reconciliation authority or auto-clear invented.
Canonical/mirrored contracts and shared implementation docs unchanged; parent owns documentation.
